description.en: This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值为100。

默认值为10。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.
The name of the snapshot-consistent group.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 快照一致性组所属的资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the snapshot-consistent group belongs.

description.zh: 指定的快照一致性组ID。N的取值范围为1~10。
description.en: The ID of the snapshot-consistent group. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh:
快照一致性组的状态。N的取值范围为1~3。取值如下：

- progressing：创建中。

- accomplished：创建成功。

- failed：创建失败。
description.en:
The status of the snapshot-consistent group. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

- progressing: The snapshot-consistent group is being created.

- accomplished: The snapshot-consistent group is created.

- failed: The snapshot-consistent group failed to be created.

description.zh: 快照一致性组的标签键值对。
description.en: The tag key-value pairs of the snapshot-consistent group.

description.zh: 快照一致性组的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。
description.en: The tag key of the snapshot-consistent group. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh: 快照一致性组的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20。
description.en: The tag value of the snapshot-consistent group. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

descriptions.zh: `InstanceId`、`SnapshotGroupId.N`和`Status.N`不是必需的请求参数，但是可以构建过滤器逻辑，参数之间为逻辑与（And）关系。
descriptions.en: `InstanceId`, `SnapshotGroupId.N`, and `Status.N` are not required request parameters, but they can be used to build filter logic. The parameters have a logical AND relationship.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-snapshot-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-j6ca469urv8ei6290000 --name testName --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --max-results 10 --snapshot-group-id ssg-j6ciyh3k52qp7ovm0000 --status accomplished --additional-attributes example-string --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeSnapshotGroups --region cn-hangzhou --Status.1 accomplished --Tag.1.Key TestKey --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --InstanceId 'i-j6ca469urv8ei6290000' --SnapshotGroupId.1 'ssg-j6ciyh3k52qp7ovm0000' --MaxResults 10 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AdditionalAttributes.1 'example-string' --Name testName
